prediction_question: At the instant IBAMA issues a new environmental infraction notice (auto de infracao, lavratura) against an entity, will the same entity (CPF/CNPJ) receive another IBAMA infraction notice within the following 12 months?
prediction_time: The prediction instant is the lavratura instant: DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO of the current auto de infracao, the earliest documented moment the enforcement act exists (recorded by the electronic AI-e form since 2019-10-08, and by the launch date DT_LANCAMENTO for the pre-2019 analogue SICAFI series). Features are restricted to (a) the current auto's issuance-time attributes (infraction type/code, proposed sanction TIPO_AUTO, initial value VAL_AUTO_INFRACAO, gravity classification GRAVIDADE_INFRACAO, conduct MOTIVACAO_CONDUTA, UF/municipio, bioma, action motivation TIPO_ACAO, operation name) and (b) the entity's PRIOR autos only (DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO strictly earlier than the instant). Post-instant process events defined by IN Ibama 19/2023 (ciencia of the auto, defense, julgamento in first instance ~30 days from file receipt, appeal ~20 days, second instance, Cadin inclusion) are label-window events of the current auto's lifecycle, never features. LIMITATION, recorded: the daily export is current-vintage only (no publisher archive of past exports); prior-history features are therefore current-vintage rows with per-row DT_ULT_ALTERACAO / TP_ULT_ALTERACAO / JUSTIFICATIVA_ALTERACAO available to quantify how much history was revised. The 12-month target window follows the prediction instant entirely.
target_definition: Binary label: exists another auto de infracao in the same published table with identical CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR and DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO in (T, T+365 days], where T is the current auto's lavratura instant. Label source columns: CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR and DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO; both excludable from shipped features (entity keys shipped hashed). Censoring: right-censoring at the last observed lavratura date in the extract; entities leaving enforcement attention are treated as no re-autuacao observed (this is a re-AUTUACAO task, not a reoffense task - enforcement effort confound stated in the task card, not hidden).

sources.name: IBAMA Dados Abertos - Julgamentos de Auto de Infração (per-state SICAFI volume reports) - NEGATIVE probe for the adjudication label
sources.access: Per-state volume/count reports by bem tutelado (HTML/CSV/JSON/XML). Probed because the primary adjudication-outcome task needs per-auto julgamento results: this dataset is a volume summary, NOT per-auto detail. The final decision on each auto is made in the linked administrative process (NUM_PROCESSO), whose content is available only via per-process SEI access - not bulk. CONSEQUENCE recorded: the 'will the fine be sustained at julgamento' task has no obtainable per-auto label from open data and was rejected for this source; the recidivism task does not need it.

licence_note: Class A reasoning, recorded: IBAMA is federal Executive branch (autarquia federal); the dataset is published on the publisher's official open-data platform and is itself marked 'Outra (Aberta)' (Other/Open) at dataset level. The governing instrument is Decreto 8.777/2016 as amended by Decreto 9.903/2019, which defines federal open data as published under an open licence allowing free use with attribution of source only, and authorizes free use of Union-held databases. No dataset-specific restrictive terms exist on the dataset page (read in full in the supported browser). Redistributing derived rows therefore requires crediting IBAMA as the source. Personal-data design note (LGPD): rows carry NOME_INFRATOR and CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR of individuals; these are public enforcement acts published openly by the authority, but the shipped dataset must hash entity keys (or restrict to CNPJ legal entities) and must not ship raw individual identifiers as features; to be settled at construction.
license_evidence: Decreto 8.777/2016, art. 2, III (DOU 2016-05-12, via in.gov.br, read 2026-10-30): 'dados abertos - dados acessiveis ao publico, representados em meio digital, estruturados em formato aberto, processaveis por maquina, referenciados na internet e disponibilizados sob licenca aberta que permita sua livre utilizacao, consumo ou cruzamento, limitando-se a creditar a autoria ou a fonte.'

Decreto 8.777/2016, art. 3 (as amended by Decreto 9.903/2019, planalto.gov.br, read 2026-10-30): 'IV - permissao irrestrita de reuso das bases de dados publicadas em formato aberto;' and art. 4: 'Os dados disponibilizados pelo Poder Executivo federal e as informacoes de transparencia ativa sao de livre utilizacao pelos Poderes Publicos e pela sociedade. Paragrafo 1o Fica autorizada a utilizacao gratuita das bases de dados ... cujo detentor de direitos autorais patrimoniais seja a Uniao.'

Publisher dataset page (dadosabertos.ibama.gov.br/dataset/fiscalizacao-auto-de-infracao, read in the supported browser 2026-10-30): 'Informacoes Adicionais ... Licenca: Outra (Aberta)'; resource page repeats 'Licenca: Outra (Aberta)'. No dataset-specific terms restricting alteration or transfer are stated on the page.

Publisher's own tutorial (gov.br/ibama, 2025-10-10 tutorial PDF, fetched 2026-10-30, 5,765,859 bytes) directs users to the open-data platform for the complete per-auto spreadsheets ('Para baixar planilhas completas dos Formularios lavrados, sugerimos utilizar a Plataforma de Dados Abertos do Ibama'), confirming this is the publisher's intended bulk distribution channel.
split_strategy: Entity-instant panel over all autos 1980-2026: one row per (entity, auto) with the entity's prior history at lavratura. Candidate temporal windows on lavratura year, boundaries avoiding the SICAFI->AIe form regime change (2019-10-08) and the 2020-21 enforcement dip: train 2005-2015 / eval 2016-2019 / holdout 2022-2025. Both classes per window are expected but NOT yet measured on the full table - the decisive worker probe must compute per-window positives/negatives AND clustered counts: positives cluster at least by entity (a recidivist contributes many positives) and by fiscalizacao operation (SEQ_ACAO_FISCALIZATORIA sweeps autuam many entities at once) and by municipality. UNRESOLVED until measured: split capacity, per-window class counts, clustered (independent) positive counts, and the share of rows with a usable entity key (CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR non-empty, valid) per year.

Key documented fields: SEQ_AUTO_INFRACAO (PK), NUM_AUTO_INFRACAO + SER_AUTO_INFRACAO (SICAFI analogue series up to 2019-10-07; alphanumeric AI-e series from 2019-10-08), DES_STATUS_FORMULARIO (Lavrado/Cancelado/Danificado/Extraviado/Substituido por outro/Impresso/Excluido), SIT_CANCELADO (S/N), TIPO_AUTO (multa simples/multa diaria/advertencia), TIPO_MULTA (aberta/fechada), VAL_AUTO_INFRACAO (initial value proposed by the agent), PATRIMONIO_APURACAO, GRAVIDADE_INFRACAO (Leve/Media/Grave), MOTIVACAO_CONDUTA, EFEITO_MEIO_AMBIENTE, EFEITO_SAUDE_PUBLICA, PASSIVEL_RECUPERACAO, DAT_HORA_AUTO_INFRACAO (lavratura), DAT_CIENCIA_AUTUACAO, DT_FATO_INFRACIONAL, COD_MUNICIPIO/MUNICIPIO/UF, NUM_PROCESSO/NU_PROCESSO_FORMATADO, COD_INFRACAO/DES_INFRACAO/TIPO_INFRACAO (fauna/flora/pesca/controle ambiental/etc.), NOME_INFRATOR, CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR, QT_AREA, longitude/latitude/WKT, UNIDADE_CONSERVACAO, DS_BIOMAS_ATINGIDOS, SEQ_ACAO_FISCALIZATORIA, TIPO_ACAO (operacao/fortuito/rotina/demanda juridica/linha verde), OPERACAO, DT_LANCAMENTO, DT_ULT_ALTERACAO, TP_ULT_ALTERACAO, JUSTIFICATIVA_ALTERACAO, ULTIMA_ATUALIZACAO_RELATORIO. Aux tables confirmed served semicolon-separated UTF-8-BOM CSV keyed on SEQ_AUTO_INFRACAO (Range sample 2026-10-30).
measurements.publisher_duplication_warning: Publisher resource note (read 2026-10-30): from October 2019 some autos appear more than once when associated with more than one autuacao polygon or other attributes, so counts in that period can be overestimated - dedupe on SEQ_AUTO_INFRACAO required before any aggregate.
measurements.literature_anchor_counts: ANPEC 2018 paper and Journal of Quantitative Criminology 2023 (vol 39) both use IBAMA flora infractions 2000-2010 at individual level: 127,873 records, 98,006 violators; recidivism cases 23.36% of infringements; 15.1% of violators are recidivists (their flora-only subset). These are literature figures for design context, NOT measurements of the current full table; the current table (all infraction types, 1980-2026) is larger and must be measured on the worker.
measurements.regime_change_note: SICAFI (analogue, series-numbered autos) ended 2019-10-07; AIe (electronic, alphanumeric) from 2019-10-08. Feature semantics for form-era fields (SER_AUTO_INFRACAO, UNID_ARRECADACAO) change across the boundary; construction must not treat the two series as one population without checking.

review: Brazil federal environmental enforcement table, per-auto detail from 1980, machine-readable, daily export, attribution-only federal open-data regime (class A with credit-the-source duty). The natural adjudication task (fine sustained at julgamento) is NOT buildable: the published julgamentos dataset is a per-state volume summary and per-process outcomes live only in SEI (per-process manual access) - recorded as a negative probe. The viable task is infractor-level re-autuacao within 12 months of a new auto, whose label needs only the autos table itself (CPF_CNPJ_INFRATOR + lavratura dates), features are documented-by-publisher, and the prediction instant (lavratura) precedes all post-instant process events. Prior art is econometrics/criminology (survival analysis of IBAMA recidivism, flora 2000-2010) with no ML-ready benchmark, splits or scored contract located - differentiation recorded via check-novelty. Strongest remaining uncertainties: split capacity with clustered counts and entity-key coverage per year on the FULL table (worker probe required), the current-vintage feature policy (measurable via DT_ULT_ALTERACAO rates), and LGPD-safe entity-key shipping.
next_action: Bounded next probes, in order (discovery remains owner until the worker probe): (1) WORKER-SIDE AGGREGATE PROBE (bulk data stays off the coordinator): stream auto_infracao_csv.zip ONCE, dedupe on SEQ_AUTO_INFRACAO, and compute per-lavratura-year row counts; share of rows with valid non-empty CPF_CNPJ_INFRACAO (pessoa fisica vs CNPJ); 12-month re-autuacao base rate per year for first-time and repeat entities; clustered positive counts by entity and by SEQ_ACAO_FISCALIZATORIA; SIT_CANCELADO / DES_STATUS_FORMULARIO mix per year (current-vintage revision evidence). (2) Cross-check against the publisher's own summary products: the annual 'Diagnostico de Delitos Ambientais' PDFs and the 'Multas Ambientais Distribuidas por Bens Tutelados' dataset. (3) Reconcile five contracts with (1)+(2) evidence; refresh the novelty verdict; only then ready-or-park with split counts recorded. Construction, if advanced, hands to advancement on a worker with the standard order (construct -> gate -> accept -> references).

novelty_check.theirs: IBAMA publishes the raw per-auto table and volume summaries but no prediction task; ANPEC 2018 and Journal of Quantitative Criminology 39 (2023) use IBAMA flora infractions 2000-2010 for causal survival analysis of recidivism (no benchmark, splits or scored contract); US EPA/OECA recidivism-rate reports are program measurement; no ML-ready environmental-enforcement recidivism benchmark located in any jurisdiction.
novelty_check.ours: ML-ready, publication-instant-gated prediction task over the full IBAMA per-auto table (all infraction types, 1980-2026): at each auto's lavratura instant, predict same-entity (CPF/CNPJ) re-autuacao within 12 months; hashed entity keys, documented current-vintage feature policy, temporal splits avoiding the 2019-10 SICAFI/AIe regime change, clustered (entity and operation level) split counts, scored evaluation contract.
novelty_check.rule: A dataset that already exists in ML-ready form is not published. Mirroring is a failure mode, not a contribution.
